Name: Seasonal Stag
Author: MasterAki
Description:
I just made this cause I'm planning to play the new update as an elf dude and I thought riding a stag makes it look nice,
I thought since I put a lot of effort, although there is still some need for a fix here and there, I'll fix it when im not lazy XD

Anyone is free to edit the sprites and the code, the only thing I ask is linking this mod page if you repost.

The comes with new skins for both the horse and stable.
(Note that the horse skin will affect the color of the stables).

This mod contains:
- 4 horse skin (spring, summer, fall and winter)
- 4 stable sprite (spring, summer, fall and winter)

[b]Installation guide:[/b]

- Download the zip file [b]'Seasonal Stag,zip'[/b]
- Extract it
- put it in the mods folder [b]Stardew Valley/mods

Other horse replacer mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20282]Hellcycle at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url][/b]
